Best morning of the year, easily. I have been surfing this coast for twenty years and I have only seen it like that maybe five times. Saturday, six in the morning. The wind went offshore overnight, the swell arrived at exactly the right size, and the water was glass. There were four of us. Four. On a Saturday. I caught eleven waves in three hours, which never happens, and I came in so exhausted that I sat in the car for twenty minutes before I could drive. I have not stopped talking about it since.

And I missed it. I have missed exactly one good day this year and of course it was that one. I set the alarm for five, like always, and then I turned it off in my sleep, which I have never done before. I woke up at half past eight and I knew immediately, because the group chat had forty messages. By the time I got there the wind had swung and it was choppy and full of people. So that is my story. I have learned one thing: the alarm goes on the other side of the room from now on.
